o1.biggest_mistake: Some primary text runs long and reads like a spec list, so it drifts from the short-line, grade 7 voice. Concepts 2, 6 and 8 are still fairly static-on-scene, closer to what we already run.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Cut the primary text to short, punchy lines. Make one of the statics a more distinct format, such as a UGC or creator piece. Give each concept a single named test variable.

o2.biggest_mistake: Several lines put claims in our own voice that are not approved specs: 'No rattle', 'Quiet wheels' in the brand copy, 'rolls quiet'. o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Keep 'quiet' strictly to review quotes and drop the on-screen dimensions. Set a realistic test budget per concept. Lead the top three with the women's concept, since that is the cheapest proven audience.

reason: Both are strong and I'd use either. Output 2 sounds more like us, but Output 1 stays inside my approved claims and gives a test budget I'd actually trust, so I'd ship it first.
